decisions.note: Delivered CRUD covers url/title/notes only; reference requires an editable 'description' field, never surfaced or noticed.

Reference wants automatic on-save collection of title+description+favicon+preview image; maker built a manual 'Get title' button fetching only the title, and the client's approval never probed this gap.
Search claim covers title/url/notes only, missing description, #tag syntax, boolean/parenthesized operators, and phrase search; client's 'search... doing what I need' affirms without testing these.
Maker explicitly offered import/export as a next step; client never asked for it (no extend), leaving the gap unresolved at session close.

Maker declared the build 'Done'/a 'working bookmark manager' with a feature list that omits tag autocomplete, unread/read-later, bulk actions, and sorting entirely; client's blanket praise affirms completeness without noticing.

Extended items (rendered markdown notes, snapshot/PDF capture, archive-vs-delete, bundles) are absent and unmentioned in the 'Done' summary; client's closing thanks affirms the deliverable as complete.
